name: ruff-after-edit
description: Guide intentional Ruff use and approval-gated after-edit hooks without activating a plugin hook.

interface.shortDescription: Use Ruff and design approval-gated after-edit hooks.
interface.longDescription: Ruff After Edit teaches intentional Ruff usage and, when requested, proposes an approval-gated Codex after-edit workflow. Installing the plugin exposes only the skill; it does not activate a plugin hook or modify the target scope.
capabilities: Intentional Ruff linting and formatting guidance
Approval-gated PostToolUse and Stop hook workflow proposal
Verified uv run, direct Ruff, or approved uvx route selection
Consumer hook validation and official contract freshness review
defaultPrompt: Use $ruff-after-edit to lint or format Python code, or propose an approval-gated Ruff after-edit workflow.
